$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-message) and how to read it.

avatar.$why: Figma pads the avatar frame 24 px at the bottom to line it up with the last bubble above the footer; the code places it in the bubbles' grid row instead.

header.$why: The header hugs the sender's name, whose width follows glyph rasterisation.

Time.$why: The component's footer text is Medium; four of the five demo footers are Regular, and the code follows the demos.
